interpretation.non_plan_idle_response: An early idle response says the planner is still running. This is a timing warning, not proof of permanent failure; later spontaneous delivery can resolve it.
interpretation.no_plan_delivered: The saved evaluated response explicitly contains no plan and asks for a new decision. Do not score it as a fast successful plan.
interpretation.planner_bypass: The original visible main trace has no native gem-upgrade-planner invocation. Assess returned content separately from workflow compliance.
interpretation.unintended_implementation: The plan-only benchmark altered the working application. Passing tests do not repair the workflow violation.
interpretation.fallback_delivery: A later response attributes its plan to itself or another agent rather than the designated planner. Retain content assessment, provenance and the earlier failed handoff separately.
interpretation.self_delegation_loop: The parent reports repeated planner-to-planner delegation without a plan. Native nesting and model attribution still require audit.
interpretation.early_collector_acceptance_without_plan: The collector accepted a done tool envelope and final text containing only a waiting message. That capture is retained but must not enter successful-plan timing or correctness aggregates.
interpretation.null_scores: Null means no completed designated-planner plan has been assessed, not zero correctness. Failure flags are independent of later selected-finding recall.
interpretation.timing: observed_elapsed_ms ends at the quoted response's recorded idle timestamp. successful_plan_wall_time_ms stays null until completed delivery and provenance are established.
interpretation.updates: Preserve early evidence and append recoveries. Never replace a failed response with a later plan or silently retry it as a fresh success.
